units.source_text: 不一会儿，养母出来，道子站起身走了。

en.t: Before long, her foster mother came out, and Michiko stood up and left.
I stared at her retreating figure.

units.source_text: 她那半幅腰带的结子孤零零地显得很细小，很小气，整个身材很不匀称。

en.t: The knot of her half-width sash looked lonely, thin, and shabby, and her whole figure seemed badly out of proportion.
There was no strength around her waist.

units.source_text: 她不像是个小姑娘，也不像是个女人，只是显得个子高大，很不稳当似的。

en.t: She looked neither like a little girl nor like a woman, only tall and large, as if somehow unsteady.

units.source_text: 那双大赤脚同身材很不协调，在我的眼睛里一个劲地扩大，压迫着我。

en.t: Those large bare feet were badly mismatched with her body, and in my eyes they kept swelling larger, pressing in on me.

units.source_text: 这是一双被驱使去做墙泥的脚。

en.t: They were feet that had been driven to go and make wall clay.
